'''2002 NYC Mini-Open Scott Lingrell DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2002 NYC Mini-Open]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell (2004-01-28).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=31369 Lingrell's NYC Dark Deck]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070211003112/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=31369&PHPSESSID=84d2b1152e98cb77a826b3278db9feed Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Event per post header "Dark Side Decklist for NYC Mini-Open" (2002); posted Jan 2004.<ref name="src" />
